fields.Fire Shield: Warm: The plate grants Warm. Action on yourself once per Long Rest. For 10 turns, gain Cold resistance and deal 2d8 Fire to a melee attacker who hits you, or 4d8 on a critical hit. The spell describes a 10 ft light radius, but the pinned rules report no gameplay light effect.
